access_token.description: Docker Hub bearer token for authenticated organization and SCIM operations. Store it through the credential flow; never pass it inline.

docker_username.description: Docker Hub username or organization namespace to read repositories, tags, and the namespace profile for. Lowercase alphanumerics, underscores, and hyphens only.

repository.description: Repository name (without the namespace prefix) the 'tags'/'repository_detail'/'tag_detail' streams are scoped to. Required only when reading one of those streams.

tag.description: Tag name the 'tag_detail' stream reads a single tag record for (e.g. 'latest'). Required only when reading the 'tag_detail' stream.

base_url.description: Docker Hub registry API base URL override for tests or self-hosted proxies.

page_size.description: Page size (1-100) for the initial request of each paginated stream (Docker Hub's page_size query param); subsequent pages follow the API's own absolute next URL verbatim.

password.description: Docker Hub password or personal access token for the documented /v2/users/login credential-minting route. It is secret material and is intentionally not accepted inline.

login_2fa_token.description: Intermediate 2FA token returned by the documented /v2/users/login route. It is secret material and is intentionally not accepted inline.

code.description: Time-based one-time password for the documented /v2/users/2fa-login route. It is secret material and is intentionally not accepted inline.

secret.description: Password, personal access token, or organization access token accepted by the documented /v2/auth/token route. It is secret material and is intentionally not accepted inline.
